conversations.answer: Ask the customer to use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes; if it has expired they can request a fresh one. Customers with 2FA enabled complete the 2FA challenge after choosing the new password.
Invoices are available under Billing > Invoices and can be re-sent to the account email from that screen.
